title: Frameworks for Large Language Model Serving in HPC Environments
problem: LLM serving in HPC lacks unified frameworks for batch/interactive workloads; complexity of resource management
motivation: Growing need for LLM inference in HPC; diverse workloads require specialized scheduling and resource allocation
method: Three complementary frameworks: AI-Flux (batch), Ray Serve (dynamic), Illinois Chat (always-on)
key_novelty: Integrated LLM serving frameworks for HPC; OpenAI-compatible APIs; hierarchical resource management
contributions: AI-Flux framework for high-throughput batch LLM inference
Ray Serve integration for dynamic interactive serving
Illinois Chat production platform for real-time LLM access
Simplified resource abstraction for HPC users
